E1_passive_single_node.verdict: passive load alone needs T_clear ≈ 99 x T_settle; adopt R-2 active reset

R2_reading: with reset conductance k·(1/R_L) during the reset phase, the ratio drops as 1/(1+k); k≈99 brings it to ≈1 (clear as fast as settle). k is set by the reset FET conductance, a DESIGN quantity with a physical cost (reset drain current from the rail).
E2_reading: V_o,min = θ + G_min·V_REF/gm; a small total load resistance forces a large G_min and a V_o,min well above 0.3 V, tightening the observation-hold inequality V_set·exp(−T_hold/τ_o) ≥ V_o,min.

a_reference_subtraction.needs: a reference node tracking V_H (same supply, matched divider) + a subtraction node; built from Capacitor/MOSFET/PowerRail

b_inhibitory_normally_on.error_location: residual reverse write when y=1 (incomplete turn-off)
b_inhibitory_normally_on.needs: a normally-on channel turned OFF by s; the repo MOSFET is enhancement-only (conducts above threshold), so this is not available as a primitive — would need a new depletion/inhibitory element with its own Q1-Q3

R3_choice: (a) reference subtraction — equal first-order ε_α bound to (b), and (b) requires a new non-primitive normally-on element. Choose (a); keep (b) documented.

timing_feasibility.note: the observation window must close after the latest valid later occurrence (t_on + latency_max + settle) AND the write must finish before e drops below the FET threshold (t_up + 2072 steps under the OLD non-causal drive). With latency up to 637 steps the remaining settle+write budget is at most 1435 steps, minus the later stimulus onset offset. The causal drive (E-6) changes e; this budget is therefore OPEN until D1 re-measures e.
timing_feasibility.T_clear_not_in_e_window: clearing happens AFTER the write, so it costs cycle length (wall clock), not e-window budget

joint_feasible_point_ratio_level.reading: a consistent point exists in ratio terms: R_S+R_L ≥ 141 (so that V_o,min ≤ 1.0 V within a 2 V supply), C_s ≤ 1.54e-04 so that the latest event settles within 100 steps, τ_o ≥ 1.44·T_hold, plus an active reset with k ≈ 99 to clear as fast as it settles. Absolute values remain OPEN until the causal e window fixes T_hold.
